name: Awayuki
source:
[i]"It's okay. Don't be afraid... I'm not going to eat you, you know! ♪"[/i]

The woman who's been taking care of your health after you(♀) wandered into this strange world.

Awayuki is kind and gentle, but she has a mischievous side to her and can be hard to read as well. At times somewhat sadistic, she also enjoys spoiling you to bits.

Her true form is that of a frigid yuki-onna. Yōkai often come seeking her services as a doctor, but likewise there are many out there who fear her.

#older_sister_type
#loves_teasing_you
#172cm_tall
#killed_you_once_before

[i]"... And after I managed to accept losing you. I don't know what to think anymore."[/i]

[Translated from [url=https://x.com/pukari_ukiwa/status/1959197488076009838]the author's Twitter.[/url]]
